title: Mythic Deep Dive
one_line_rule: Type a Greek myth name that fits the prompt, then tap SUBMIT.

brief.intent: Krillion like game but centered on greek mythology
brief.notes: Timed answers with fixed rarity points and dive depth. The same question must accept different valid typed answers and award different points based on a prewritten rarity table. Use the keyboard fragment. Keep prompts and valid answer groups as flat content lists of strings. Any content_answers reference requires an exact top-level content key answers with a flat array of strings. Use seven prompts with at least three different valid names per prompt and integer rarity points. Provide an on-screen submit key. Do not use the quiz fragment or single-correct-answer trivia.
